about: A MODELLED 50-person UK office (not a client). Every operational department's work is mapped to the AI that runs it and the AI-native lead who oversees it. The modelled parameters below are the design's own numbers — change them and the kernel recomputes every figure.

departments.name: Customer service
departments.work: Inbound email, chat and phone; orders, returns, complaints, refunds.

departments.name: Sales and business development
departments.work: Lead qualification, outreach, proposals, follow-ups, pipeline upkeep.

departments.name: Finance and accounts
departments.work: Invoicing, payables, reconciliation, credit control, VAT, month-end.

departments.name: HR and administration
departments.work: Recruitment admin, onboarding, records, rotas, policies, office admin.

departments.name: Operations and delivery
departments.work: Scheduling, suppliers, logistics, project tracking, quality checks.

departments.name: IT and systems
departments.work: Devices, access, tier-1 support, the systems themselves.

retained.focus: Direction, the biggest relationships, the final sign-off. Holds the company's genesis key.
Runs the service, sales and marketing agents; takes every escalation; closes the deals the AI qualifies.
Signs the books (the vault's witness), approves pay and spend, handles every people decision.
Owns delivery; handles supplier and customer exceptions the agents raise.
Runs the mesh, the AI boxes and the hub; tunes the agents; the capable verifier for AI output.

transition.about: The one-off move: every role that goes is paid statutory redundancy and works its notice inside the dual-running months (the old team and the agents run side by side while each department switches over); the people who stay are trained; a contingency covers what the plan missed. Change any of these to yours.
